summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Continuum MVP. 23/23 pytest backend tests pass covering magic-link auth (single-use + 401 flows), seed integrity (47/18/12/7/11 & baseline 64), deterministic scoring (Sarah=87, breakdown sums to 87, 4 critical/high people), simulation (Sarah 90d = 64/39/82 with counts 7/3/8/4; durations 7/30/3650 -> 55/48/32; determinism; other person; 404), action center (5 actions, completing 3 Sarah actions -> current_score 82, reopen -> 64, unknown id 404), search (acme -> client+knowledge), insights, CSV import (valid + bad extension + missing columns). Frontend Playwright covered full demo journey (login -> overview 64 & 4 critical -> Sarah button -> Human Manual 87 -> all 6 tabs -> Simulator 64/39/82 -> compare 4 columns -> Action Center completing all Sarah actions -> action-current-score 82 -> reopen -> 64), dependency map (23 nodes for Sarah focus, focus switcher works, critical-only filter reduced 23->20, non-person node click shows detail + clear-selection-button, then clears), People register (search filter, empty state, tier=critical filter, row -> human manual), global search (input + result nav to /people/sarah-mitchell), logout -> /login, protected route redirects, and mobile 430x860 responsive check on /overview /map /simulate /actions with zero horizontal overflow. All critical acceptance criteria from the spec verified. Cleanup: reopened all completed actions and deleted imported TEST_ person from MongoDB so org state is back to baseline (score 64, 47 people).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_graph() is called multiple times per request in some endpoints (e.g. GET /api/actions re-loads graph + calls load_actions twice). Cheap for demo, but consider caching per-request for larger orgs.
GET /api/dependencies always falls back to people[0] when focus id is unknown instead of returning 404 - silently masks bad ids from the UI. Consider returning 404 or an explicit warning.

seed_organization() runs on every backend startup and rewrites everything with source != 'import'. That means any manual, non-import edits (mitigation action status is protected via $setOnInsert, but people/processes/clients edits would be lost). This is fine for a demo but worth documenting.

engine.duration_factor(): for a duration not in DURATION_FACTORS the fallback formula `days/90` clamped to 1.3 is coarse - a duration like 60 would return 0.67 which is very close to the 30-day factor (0.65). Not a bug, just non-monotonic near boundaries.
CORS is open ('*') with allow_credentials=False - acceptable for the preview but should be tightened before any production use.
No rate-limiting on /api/auth/request-link - a script could enumerate email addresses. For a contest MVP this is acceptable.
test_credentials: Magic-link demo: demo@northstar.example (POST /api/auth/request-link -> demo_token -> /api/auth/verify -> session_token). See /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Test suite imports a TEST_Alice Example row via /api/import/people during CSV test; the test cleanup step at the end deletes all people with source='import' from MongoDB so the org returns to 47 seeded employees. Sarah's 3 mitigation actions were toggled Completed then Open again; final org current_score confirmed = 64.
